## Context / Problem
An immutable census of all 247 prose blocks (125 true leading docstrings, 122 maximal full-line comment regions) in these eighteen workflow-test modules found 54 editable blocks (35 docstrings, 19 comment regions; 4,560 before-words), frozen at `origin/main@d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`. Shifted attribution ranges were remapped; the concise motivating-size comment is protected.

## Approach
Edit only the frozen prose blocks below. A `D:<owner>` is the leading `Expr(Constant(str))` in a `Module`, `ClassDef`, `FunctionDef`, or `AsyncFunctionDef`. A `C:<scope>:before:<anchor>` is one maximal consecutive full-line COMMENT-token region, owned by the innermost AST scope and anchored to a following unchanged non-comment code. Compact `D{a,b}` and `C{scope@anchor,...}` notation expands to those exact IDs under the row's path; the reviewer writes the fully path-qualified `<path>#<ID>`.

For every owned path, retain immutable before and final blobs and parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`. On comparison copies remove only allowlisted leading docstring nodes; normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`; require the remaining `ast.dump(..., include_attributes=False)` values to match. Tokenize both blobs and reject changed inline comments or non-allowlisted full-line comments. Preserve runtime strings, regexes, prompts, imports, decorators, annotations, assertions, subprocess arguments, test data, shebangs, and complete directive-bearing physical lines exactly. Only adjacent blank-line normalization around an edited block is allowed.

## Protected false positives
All 193 unlisted blocks are protected. This explicitly includes the concise `_NINE_FD4_CHARS` fixture-size comment; per-assert editor labels; helper/test docstrings already stating one invariant; non-allowlisted section banners; `# loopback only`; and every `noqa`, `pragma`, and `type: ignore` line. Runtime strings containing shell, JSON, YAML, URLs, regexes, prompt text, and fake credentials remain byte-exact.

## Preserved contracts and consumers
Keep model observation below `RunnerAgentStep`, distinct hermetic class sentinels, per-step usage/class attribution, runner-produced verdict provenance and honest absence/recovery; caller-owned graph scope; failing-run consumption metrics; actionable-bank outage fallback and retryable botocore classification; pinned-root prefetch/globs; physical own-window and economic product bounds; full-context no-elision and pre-call refusal; prelude diagnostics; typed budget recovery and short-run rendering; PASS-cache fingerprint/concurrent-write rules; child closure and certification withholding; zero-LLM DET blocking; repository-relative authoring globs; narrow effective-policy projection; and editor structured-only/routing/validate-before-write behavior. The DET module imports fixtures from `test_plan_review_workflow.py`; editor suites check downstream behavior but do not read this prose. The required import/guard/selector/doc-consumer searches found no allowlisted prose reader.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Only the declared stable-ID blocks and adjacent blank lines change; the AST and token/comment comparisons pass on every owned path.
- [ ] Every edited block is shorter and retains the listed current contract while removing chronology, duplication, obvious narration, or separator ornament.
- [ ] A non-author reviewer posts exactly 54 leaf-linked TSV rows: `stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
- [ ] Before citations use `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84:<path>#<stable-id>`; final citations use `<final-commit-sha>:<path>#<stable-id>`; every row has `after_words < before_words` and records `directives_exact=PASS`, `semantic-preservation=PASS`, and `bloat-removal=PASS`.
- [ ] All five structured verify commands pass.

## Verification
The five DD-level commands recorded on this ticket run focused pytest with real consumers, scoped Ruff check plus format-check, comment hygiene, owned-path diff integrity, and untimed worktree-venv `make verify`. They are the executable completion oracle.
